notes.content: [h2]New Sol Intro Story Movie[/h2][p]Thanks to the modern advancements of AI animation, we are happy to introduce new lifelike movies/stories to SpaceWars.  It brings in more immersion to the game, and gives you an introduction to the companion novels' characters.  So once you select your Sol character, enjoy the intro [b][url="https://youtu.be/9TnmL4WJrLo"]movie[/url][/b] before entering the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/46cf3842bc324351c26d2a078306cfa83739652c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Sol Human Avatars[/h2][p]The older hand-drawn Captains have been completely replaced with new, more lifelike versions, including premium variants.  Free peoples and Genari have been updated as well.[/p][p]Captain Madani ([i]a Sol Imperial Worlds character in the novel)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/c46321511ab9a1b59045e74d18c5d57d55a8ae9d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Rear Admiral Jamshidi ([i]a Sol Imperial Worlds character in the novel)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/d3be144a00970d0fecba4508bd58cc546fa69b71.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/f873b8e07eca62b77186d40720ddcf4448bc4500.jpg"][/img][i]Obayda Zueiter (a Free Peoples' of Sol character in the novel)[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Advanced Attack AI[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/21c6131ee2cd93da09ea74c81667496e1e0b10a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The SpaceWars AI has been mostly a companion AI for fleet commander's secondary ships and to defend sectors that players attack; but now it has enough 'intelligence' to select sectors and attack on its own.[/p][p]So every race now has its own AI players/ships, which strike border sectors with class III and IV ships. However, beware of the more advanced Hero AI that will come with class V and VI destroyers and light cruisers and significant crew upgrades.  These special AI will play similar to a veteran-skilled player and are extremely challenging. You will notice their uniqueness with their 'premium' captain avatars.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/dc4f20466a431faaab7ab1c4d9c5dd29d6f2e27d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Previous PvP Server Chiron II won by Sol in a domination victory[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/eebfa39a177bd81b6a014f1e6b9ca580e7ecaabd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Congrats to 101 for holding out against the dominance of Sol (with over 1.8 mil XP), and keeping the Dyson sphere from attack.  Spamalot, Teckonte, Winterforce, Equaa, Wister all helped in conquering over 85% of the galaxy map as Sol.  Beo and Amish both worked as Pirates and also survived the assault.  Honorable mentions Gremlin and Anon who also made it to the top ten as Hive and Genari.[/p]

notes.title: New Server: Saneth
notes.content:
[h2]New Server: Saneth[/h2]
[b]New five-faction server is now up![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/313a150b81c18131dbd56ccc3379be0c4eac6fd8.jpg[/img]
[i]The Genari Starkiller arrives in orbit around Earth, with the Sol Imperial defense platform nearby[/i]

A fierce battle between Sol Imperial Worlds and Genari United Empire ended with the Sol Homeworld of Earth being defeated led by RevenyasReven and his Starkiller flagship.  The hive was defeated first, and Ma'Alaketh thereafter, with Sol being the last one standing against the Genari.
Also, congrats to Taco, Mentor, Amishjoe, BurgerBing, Doc Grumpets as the great defenders of Sol, eventually succumbing to Genari.

[b]What class of ship will you achieve this server?[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/545e1f4796df2c0abbeeeed0001c5a8c4f81bfad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/ff3473fa55137e825a63e0840493b0ddcc8c114f.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Feature: Attack AI[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/4237475df57b34c6136cfdefab8453ff517e49b7.png[/img]
[i]A Sol Mendi fires on a Genari Agile Flyer[/i]

Players will notice a new feature implemented in this server -- Attack AI.  Not only will local stations send out defending ships when players attack borders, some stations now send out Class III and IV attackers to hit borders as well.  Take advantage of this and join AI to coordinate attacks on sectors, or defend against them for extra experience and officer points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/b38fda3850e9714671ec600990f4809b6ae0dacf.jpg[/img]

Eventually you will be seeing 'Hero Attack AI' which will be leveled up AI destroyers and cruisers that work in groups to assault larger sectors, just like you do.

notes.title: New Server: Rigel II
notes.content:
[h1]New Server: Rigel II[/h1]
[h3]A new five-faction server now online, players may choose between:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/d2f68fd872890dc16852a8cc381cc9f922782115.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/97513de5cbc78bc7cc3c7780bb8f14bc4d2a1d8d.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/44ad0262209a753c8d639feeba6a1f83a609dbe2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/ae96fce7fe03d6281e17261fd92b06bdbecf5d8f.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/f2a483ddae44f2427201021b460b8eb0620572c2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/76916ab27d745cd63464e8cdfdb7a905cbfde554.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/c0c8611783c02bacf755d0438a085cdf0c66ad49.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/6d62c0ad72704265f2ca882eceb544cbefc314d9.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/1e03685234a8eff9a9ec04c8cfdb0707876667bc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/b4ab4e9a9d99fefae7513684b42cd56c1bc8eebe.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Genari United Empire[/b] - The brutish conquerors with heavy armor, marines, alpha strike
[b]Ma'Alaketh Confederation[/b] - The most tech-advanced with powerful shields and ranged weapons
[b]Perseus Hive[/b] - Living ships that rely on sheer numbers and accelerated growth & regeneration
[b]Free Peoples of Sol[/b] - Pirates of the galaxy with the ability to strike anywhere & stolen tech

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/621ac886a6b50103cf8ed83c7edd72ed54ada64e.jpg[/img]
[i]The Sol Titan and Colossus dreadnoughts approach the Ma'Alaketh Dyson Sphere[/i]
[h1]Previous Server: Jupiter II[/h1]

John McMilan kept watch on defense.
[b]Commendations also go out to:[/b]
Genari's best players: Hook & Amishjoe
Hive's best players: Kunll & Zigzagler
Free Peoples' best players: Xeen & Mandosa

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/a3e2fc61f965efe4b4b6a1bc4988577ebf6b19e3.jpg[/img]
[i]The battleship Yamato near Earth[/i]

-The Ma'Alaketh Tetrarch light cruiser now has its hull reduced from 82 to 72.

notes.title: Pirates! The Free Peoples of Sol
notes.content:
[h1]New Server:  Pirate PvE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/ef85428fb2945706e07072072b6aa633ee69989b.jpg[/img]

The fifth and final faction for Space Wars, the Free Peoples of Sol has finally launched.  On this server, players can try these 'Pirates', working together against AI to dominate the server.   Originating from New Terra in the Helix Nebula, this faction is a conglomeration of Human and Genari defectors that combine their technology (along with some stolen Ma'Alaketh tech) to produce some rather unique warships.

[b]Their strengths:[/b]
-Can support large fleets of AI combat ships
-Strong boarding units and xp gains from capturing ships/bounties
-Can attack any sector, regardless of being adjacent to a captured region

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/c1c93807987bcc5de08c2d1ce226c2c01562ae1d.jpg[/img]

[b]Their weaknesses:[/b]
-Very expensive ships
-No high tier battleships or dreadnaughts
-Long cooldowns for lost ships
-Only three dedicated officers
-Weak support ships

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/9e7ec1bbd44aca526b46bbbe61523df95bf33a37.png[/img]

So have fun and enjoy this new faction, with all its unique ways to conquer the galaxy :)

notes.content:
[h2]New Server:  Cruisers Maximus[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/16e7fba32e5e80b52b2fe182f2b46b630efcd0b7.jpg[/img]
This is a new four faction PvP server, with one limitation however -- all four races are limited to Class VI ships as their strongest warship.  That means Heavy Cruisers, Battleships and Dreadnoughts are not available on this server.
It will allow players to hone their skills on workhorses of their race, which are the frigates, destroyers, and light cruisers.  
Also the win parameters are not to destroy all the enemy homeworlds this time, but attempt to dominate 90% of the galaxy map.

[h2]Previous Server: Ganymede Victory to the Hive[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/55f21298ec0f98b52d4edc172421f7236192ac65.jpg[/img]
Two of the strongest Hive players worked as a team, fed off the Sol race, which collapsed first:  Veterans Nocabonac and Heinous dominated their way through Sol and Genari, eventually taking out the Ma'Alaketh Dyson Sphere to win the server.  Also a shoutout to sss, KhanJB, beo, Hook, zorg, genari_neko as Genari, initially dominating the server until the Hive grew too strong for them to hold back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/8a246e7fefd83e0593768dc7abc86f58f97d782f.jpg[/img]
New Server with all for races accessible under normal win conditions:  Sol Imperial Worlds, Genari United Empire, Ma'Alaketh Confederation, and the Perseus Hive.  Some of you veteran players who stick to the same race every time, should try other races and enjoy the flavor and variety of each... you never know you might find a new favorite!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/8774de7c4f2588e34bf47dd2e9c0a3e62c0df63a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Server: Andromeda
notes.content:
[h1]New Server: Andromeda[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/cf2ca79135e47634d2c0f064bb2de10b5d997a3c.jpg[/img]
[i]The Destiny Troop Ship navigating one of the many mined regions of Genari space[/i]

Congratulations to the Sol Imperial Worlds for successfully defeating the opposing three races, first taking out the Hive, then pushing forward through the battle-hardened Genari United Empire, and finally to the 'impregnable' Ma'Alaketh Confederation Dyson Sphere.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/7254b77d1a768fc8ce7f3a830ec939d6693c3dd5.jpg[/img]
Bravus, Thulsa Doom, Jerbear, Beo, Kingkong, and AlterEgo were the key players who helped Sol win the server.  Zeranghi, Hook, and AmishJoe tried fighting back as Genari, and Bosh'tet, Zapp, Equaa held strong against the Sol fleets as Ma'alaketh.  Though the Hive has dominated and won many servers, it was one of the first to buckle against Sol this time.  
All top ranked and most active players win 100 to 4000 credits that carries over for use on future servers, along with associated legacy medals.

The new Andromeda server starts the game fresh with a few updates:

[h3][b]Genari Marine skill Update: Explosive Pods[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/b08b97b88c9de3426875115ae7277c6e83744ec6.jpg[/img]
Now the Marine Commander of a ship can jury-rig the marine pods to explode on contact with an enemy ships' hull.  It can be quite useful against the Hive, since marines are ineffective against them.
Four Skill Levels:
[b]Explosive Pods I-IV:[/b] Pods are empty of marines, but have been loaded with explosives.   Does 1-4 damage on contact with shield or hull.

[h3][b]Explosion Radius of Ships now Extended to 8 hexes (8000km).[/b][/h3]
When a ship explodes, it does splash damage to nearby ships, based on its original power levels.  The range is now extended from four to eight hexes, but the damage itself is still at the same values.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/ac1e25565d6975c8973d2054ef36f9bbb9b2a3ae.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Server: Deimos I
notes.content:
[h1]New PvP Server: Deimos I[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/67ba6dc9ac87775f47df96e6cc4e2fd95d81236a.jpg[/img]
After several 1v1 competitions on previous servers, we return to a full four-race competition server.  Play as Sol Imperial Worlds, Genari United Empire, Ma'Alaketh Confederation or Perseus Hive.  The Pirate faction is currently being worked on, and will be available for play in future servers.

[h2]All four races have new Captain specific skills implemented:[/h2]

[b]SOL[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/99e5da98da6644485c3f0acf3f22ad3fcdec9bd9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/b3eee40bf3a2a88f1b8783f8128d79e29850cd54.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Specialization: Helm Control[/b] allows for an extra movement point for all of the players' ships
[b]Specialization: Engineering[/b] allows for an extra repair point for all of the players' ships
[b]Tactical Advantage III-V:[/b]  Adds 2 more initiative points for each level

[b]Ma'Alaketh[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/c6f8d0b605a019675f199fd551ff79902599b1ac.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/2e0015a5c96ac4e1bba458cced60cff41bc3f6d3.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Internal Repair Drone[/b] allows for an extra repair point for all of the players' ships
[b]Drone Control IV-V[/b] allows for an additional support ship for each level, up to five.

[b]Genari[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/c3efb0c564d570806b532b67b9eb3df7cf1dfe4f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/42c3b40809b16b9af7f4233cd58defdaf9faf505.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Improved Weapons[/b] skill can add extra damage boost to player weapons.
[b]Support Specialization[/b] gives player a full support role by foregoing most combat roles. Player can have up to 5 support ships, and it unlocks the [b]Genshai II Command Tender[/b].

[b]Hive[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/40681af4e24226bf1a73c44cf4ab8d373c1c22e5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/c6cfdf609226891d4d1d19d9f304191ba013f0aa.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Specialized carapace skill[/b] available, where they can add protective layers in three levels, with the highest level adding 30% more life points.
[b]Lifeforce Drain[/b] which allows improved healing when using proboscis.
[b]Vitality[/b] skills now add improved healing, increased momentum, and enhanced synapses.

All races also get a captain skill that allows their allies to warp into the same part of the sector they are present in.

[h3]Server Ended: Genari vs Hive -- Hive Victory[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/aabef5a17ff417821aec7489238d8e2aa85a72d7.png[/img]
Congrats to Iggypay, Praxus, Raebrej, Beo, and Bug as the top Hive players that won the server.   On the Genari side, Grr, Bosh'tet, Bam8,  Ein_Keko, T, and Hook were some of the stronger players that put up a good fight against the hive organisms, but were eventually overwhelmed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/8a5f3929f5863e5d57740882207963f06fdf0ea7.jpg[/img]

A special two-race only server, which has the two new races competing against each other.   Totally different styles of gameplay, the debate continues between which race is stronger?

[b]Ma'Alaketh Confederation[/b]
With ships that have incredibly powerful and efficient defensive shields, accurate long-range particle beams, and stealth dampening field, each individual ship is capable of taking on multiple ships of other races.  They also have very advanced support technology, and advanced officers to help make their ships even more efficient.

[b]Perseus Hive[/b]
An organic race, without and shield/force field technology, they rely on their regenerative abilities to keep them surviving opposing races.  Along with their ability to swarm an opponent with many organisms at once, they have unique plasma weapons that are devastating at close range.  Add to it, their crew-consuming proboscis, that can disable enemy ships quickly.

[i]Sol and Genari are AI-controlled only on this server; and they are the 'buffer' between the two opposing races.  This gives time for Hive and Ma'Alaketh to grow and prepare for first contact.[/i]

notes.title: New Server: Neptune I
notes.content:
[h1]Neptune Server Now Open![/h1]

A new server is now available with all four races open to play.  All the multi-faction battle issues that created bugs are now fixed, so there will be no 'bugged sectors' after a 3 or 4 way combat.  Also, several new ships are available to players of each race:

[b]The Sol Krakatoa[/b] (Class XI Portable Defense Platform)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/88dfa1b27b3926a759c9698abc756e3d2f9a21c5.jpg[/img]
[i]It became clear that the Fuji and Etna defense platforms were somewhat vulnerable to longer range weaponry or direct assault; so many have been placed on defensive positions along the border when Sol secured some Genari territory in late 2190.   But when the Empire started taking back territory, there wasn't enough time to replace and rebuild these stations without risking attack mid-construction.   Admiral Grace Huang had a novel idea; to make a structure similar to the Etna with a capable dark matter drive that allowed it to be transported into the contested sector.   The first variants were too weak however, and were destroyed easily.  So a larger version was developed that mated a dark matter drive with a station power plant.   It is now known as the Krakatoa, a well-armored station that has some slight capacity to move on its own.   It mounts a dozen long range beams that have omnidirectional defensive capablities, and four light repair bays to either repair itself  or its surrounding allies.   Genari combat vessels found it to be very hard to destroy, and were initially surprised when the station actually moved out of range.  Its weakness however, is that the sheer mass to move this mobile station leaves little power for its offensive weapon systems.  Though they are relatively inexpensive to build compared to an Etna, they take a considerable time to produce unlike a warship.[/i]

[b]The Genari Intimidator[/b] (Class XI Assault Platform)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/9a3c48071603d8d455a27feb83e6e3308edbf03e.jpg[/img]
[i]Empress Devagh-Moshtigh will not admit that once she saw the mobile Krakatoa stations in action, she devised her own design for a mobile weapons platform.   Even though the Intimidator  was first seen in action in 2214, her Nova commander representative insists that it was an original design in process for two decades, now finally refined into a very intimidating 'warship'.   Taking the Ghodrat weapons platform, it is a very heavily armored structure that can maneuver slowly and make its weapons bear in any direction.   Using the technology from the Starkiller Assault Dreadnought, the quad FW-9 warhead systems have been improved to deliver the increased damage potential, leaving enough power for maneuvering.   There was enough space left to mount a station-sized scanning system, so it can help detect enemies from a much greater range than most Genari warships.  It also mounts Moshtigh's experimental marine pod system, that delivers 100 marines in a swarm of 10 pods.   Theory had it that this mobile station could approach a vulnerable Sol or Ma'Alaketh station and potentially cripple the station with the singular marine assault wave.  It has yet to be tested on a station however.[/i]

[b]The Ma'Alaketh Acolyte[/b] (Class V Auxilliary Destroyer, two variants)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/c3a9d9f2b21d3922271718e7f908bcb1b741ea73.jpg[/img]
[i]This new destroyer was specifically designed to act in a dual role as a warship and a support ship:  Though the support drones have their benefits in assisting in repairs, this could be fully crewed and simultaneously be effective in combat and defending itself.  It mounts a pair of particle beams as its main offensive unit, similar to a White Light frigate, plus a trio of defense cannons to protect itself from marine pods.   Structurally different from what would seem like a Star Light destroyer at a distance, it has a pair of light repair bays and advanced medical bays in place of heavy weaponry.   It also has damage control teams that repair the ship more efficiently, regardless of its separate repair bays.  The ship has been invaluable in the war against Sol and Genari, acting as a support mechanism able to defend itself.   High Advisor So'Oraalon has also indicated the need of such a ship as their investigations of the Perseus Hive advance into Sol and Genari territory poses a possible threat in the future and well-being of the Ma'Ali people in case they are ever encountered this close to home.
[/i]
[b]The Hive Ancient Megalith[/b] (Class VIII Hardened Megalith)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/cd52056d92bac70548fee3f714d567d063d17c58.jpg[/img]
[i]The Megalith is literally the dinosaur of the Perseus Hive -- its evolutionary tree is a dead end -- as big as it is, it does not have any of the advancements of a Hive Entity.   It is resilient however:  Even some Megaliths, however rare have overgrown from feeding and developed into an even larger, older, more battle-hardened form.   Compared to the Megalith, these more 'Ancient' types are significantly larger, with more scarring and hardening.  On the surface, they seem similar, but are much harder to kill, and their offensive appendages seem to have a bigger bite.   They are still slow however, in fact slower than the Megalith, as it seems that even for the Perseus Hive, there is a limited lifespan to these creatures, and this one really showing its age.   It is very dangerous up close, but too slow to catch up to more mobile opposition.[/i]

[h2]Antares Server:  Ma'Alaketh Victory[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/3389b5cb34f2f63da06b7640f9cf950db2f2a688.jpg[/img]
Congratulations the the Ma'Alaketh Confederation faction, which ended up winning the server.  Initially, Sol Imperial Worlds had the lead, but the tide turned mid-server.  
Top ranked Ma'Alaketh players [b]Domitor, Bosh'tet, Ein_Neko, Haven[/b] and [b]Marka[/b] dominated the server, and eventually Domitor unlocked the very first Class XII ship in action, using it to help destroy Enemy homeworlds.
Honorable mentions in Sol: [b]Jerbear, Bravus[/b], and [b]Beo[/b] who tried to counter the Ma'Alaketh advance.  As well as Genari players [b]Baalrog[/b] and [b]Hook[/b] that were the last warriors standing in the broken Genari Empire.

notes.title: The New Dreadnoughts: Class XII Ships
notes.content:
[b]Each race now has a Class XII ship, which is incredibly powerful (approximately twice the strength of a class X ship).  Though very hard to attain, it provides more endgame 'boss' content in some longer run server activity.   They are listed for each race below:[/b]

[h3]Genari United Empire:  Starkiller Command Dreadnought[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/0637cb5dab2c40e529d3a6a6ebf18f59f190e6dc.jpg[/img]
Empress Talagh-Zeranghi found her Matriarchy in trouble: Advancements into Hive regions initially gained her clan a significant amount of riches from the resource-heavy regions in the Perseus cluster.   However the Hive had begun to resist and overcome her fleet's attacks.  Eventually, the tide had turned and these massive Hive Entities were growing evermore aggressive on taking back these Genari-controlled regions.  Being on the forefront of the Hive incursion, her homeworlds of Bacheh and Barghi were seeing early attacks from these organics.   The rest of the Matriarchs were too focused on the Sol Imperium and the Ma'Alaketh; so she was on her own to defend against what seemed to be an impossible foe.   Her Star Fortress was dangerously close to the Hive border, and she considered the possibility of an evacuation if the Hive did push deeper into her territory.   She commissioned a new dreadnought that could become a mobile command base, but also have the firepower and defensive strength to resist even the largest of these destructive Hive Entities.   Thus the Starkiller was born; a massive station-sized dreadnought with enough firepower to rival even the Shahavi homeworld command base.   Although it is a rather slow ship, it is heavily armored and built to accelerate the array of omnidirectional missile weapons, with a very low energy demand to fully arm its arsenal.   It could decimate any Hive ship that would come within  6000km , no matter what its size.  The rest of the Empire sees the Starkiller as the best chance of stopping the Hive from gaining any more foothold into Genari territory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/92c857096b6a48a8601f3b8a2f651ebc3c73dec3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Sol Imperial Worlds:  Titan Assault Dreadnought[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/221f19541d5f839e6516fdefd4199672d8c9b8a1.jpg[/img]
The Sol Colossus was an incredible achievement for the Imperium:  It gave the edge in the war of attrition against the Genari Star Empire.  The Genari matriarchy was falling behind on advancements to engines and weapons, putting them in a disadvantage when it came to battleships and dreadnoughts.   But it was the awakening of the Perseus Hive and its decimation of Genari bases that had Sol command concerned with a possible greater threat.   Although most of the Hive focus was in Genari territory, they were also starting to encroach dangerously close on Capella.  Upon studying some of their larger and more dangerous 'Entities', it was realized that swarms of these could easily overcome the Colossus itself.   A new, more robust platform was developed, especially after McKellan Engineerings' breakthrough of mating six engines made a three-million ton warship possible.  It came to be known as the Titan, a one-of a kind dreadnought mounting an array of twelve of the most powerful beams in three different arcs that could decimate a single Hive entity with one volley.   With enough power and detection range as a defense station, it can target enemies from an extended range and land hits before they ever have a chance of getting close.  Its sheer size also allowed for two advanced repair bays which can help the dreadnought repair more quickly, or do the same to other ships nearby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/9d46bfd33b92390436be456a13462010ea10803c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Ma'Alaketh Confederation:  Sa'Avaal Mobile Beam Platform[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/7a749f4a67a990792611faaf994843fff2ade83c.jpg[/img]
The Sovereign battleships proved to be extremely powerful in warding off Sol and Genari attacks; the enemy could not out-power the Ma'Alaketh technology or succeed in taking any of the Ma'Alaketh regions within the Perimeter without incurring heavy casualties.  But when it was time for the Ma'Alaketh Confederation to pacify the Genari and Sol homeworlds, it was proven to be quite difficult with the sheer number of station defenses surrounding these planets.   The Confederation did not want any demoralizing casualties or losses of their capital ships -- it simply was not an option.  So developing a mobile unit that could act as long range artillery, softening or destroying defensive stations without taking any harm was the logical next step.  Using technology from the Dyson Sphere itself, a mobile beam platform was built around four smaller variants of the Dyson beam, packing enough of a punch that could destroy even the largest enemy base with reasonable reliability, and completely out of enemy station weapons range.    It also has the most advanced dampening field ever built -- a large circular unit that takes up a significant portion of the superstructure, but acts as a partially effective field because of its sheer mass.  The massive IHD-9 powerplants were doubled to deliver twice as much power as the Grand Sovereign, making this mobile platform surprisingly agile and maneuverable.   However, to fully charge its four particle beams, it will need to remain near-stationary to provide the power needs of these massive weapons.   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/5d2a46c795b1a64dc5ec3a48caf2d6f2279f6934.jpg[/img]

[h3]Perseus Hive:  Hive Queen[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/8206f8fe573e02ff65f1c0d9cacb52f3154605ea.jpg[/img]
When the bulk of Matriarch Talagh-Zeranghi's forces assaulted the Hive homeworld 'Dark Core',  their armada, consisting of a Nova, several heavy cruisers and other capital ships managed to  overcome the defending organisms and destroy the Hive nest that existed there.  The Matriarch declared this as the beginning of the end for the Perseus Hive and the Dark Core's defeat as the ultimate conquest for the Empire.   She was premature in her announcement however:  Things turned sour when this station-sized organism appeared from the dark side of the barren planet about an hour later.   Undetected, it was within the planet's dead core itself; how it got out is uncertain.   As it approached, it sent waves of energy against the Nova flagship, which was already significantly damaged.  Before the flagship could escape during its dark matter transition phase, it got destroyed.    It then systematically attacked each other heavy cruiser, forcing them to retreat one by one.   All other remaining Hive organisms rallied around this superentity, and forced the rest of the Genari fleet to retreat.   It has never been encountered again, but ever since its appearance, it has broken the Genari dream of overtaking Hive space.   They've respectfully termed it the Hive 'Queen',  definitely befitting its title.   Unlike the Hive Nests which birth new Hive organisms, this Queen is mobile and acts like a Hive Entity.  If it truly can travel between star systems, there may be nothing Sol or Genari could do to stop it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/c870765ea5dcaa0a55945bb4367262bea67c9f91.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Captain Skill:  Last Stand[/h3]
When a race is on the verge of defeat, a player who is high ranking enough can select a new skill, once they've unlocked the Class XII ship:  Last Stand.   It will trigger a last defense event where they are given a Class XII ship, to use to defend their homeworld, even possibly turning the tide to their side for a while.

[h3]Major Bug Fix: Broken Multifaction Sectors[/h3]
A fix long-needed for sectors where multiple factions combat at once (the sector would potentially get bugged, and the server would not designate proper capture assignment) is now implemented on the server.  It will make 4-race PvP a lot more viable.

notes.content:
[h1]Hive Wins the Tarantula Server[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/5fff2b9736899041b4797184da4dfb09fd6fa858.jpg[/img]
In [b]66 days[/b], the Hive managed to take out all three opposing homeworlds of [b]Earth, Saneth[/b], and [b]Do'Oran[/b].   Quite surprisingly, there were more Hive players than expected on the server, even more than the Hive PvE before it.  Partly thanks to player [b]MagicSpaceCow[/b], he was a great teacher and mentor to new players coming in as Hive.  Many of them like [b]Swarm_ott[/b], [b]Haven[/b], [b]Plasmodius[/b], [b]Vostok[/b], [b]Ein_Neko[/b] joined veterans like Cow and [b]Cimex[/b] to aggressively dominate the server.  Admittedly, Hive was somewhat overpowered, and next server will bring in adjustments in line with other races.  

Genari was the first to break (Even though they were the first to launch a Battleship), but Sol held the Hive wave back for a long time before Earth collapsed.  Because Ma'Alaketh was the furthest away from the Hive's Reach, they were the last to be taken down, and the server ended when Ma'Al's massive Dyson Sphere was destroyed.

[h2]Upcoming Antares Server starts on Thursday[/h2]
[i]Antares server will start after 4pm EST on Thursday, it will be a four faction PvP with the following adjustments:[/i]

[b]Hive[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/42f05dd1979bd7b8d56a67ac37a6db507378da14.jpg[/img]

-Slight reduction in mind strength with high tier organisms (Class VII-X)
-Slight reduction in regeneration with bloated organisms as well as some high tier.

[b]Sol & Genari[/b]
-Sol/Gen Battleships and Dreadnoughts (Class IX, X) have been improved to increase the interest in achieving them and making them more resilient.   This is so that the choice between two Heavy Cruisers and a higher tier is more lucrative.
-Genari Station missiles have longer range and accuracy

[b]Ma'Alaketh[/b]
-Shadow Ships class IV and higher are now less expensive.
-Ma'alaketh Defense Stations now have two more particle beams.

[b]Itching to play Spacewars?  Well the newbie server is open until Antares opens on Thursday.[/b]

notes.title: New Server: Rigel I
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the new Rigel server! [/h1]

[b]Competition begins with the fully playable races of Sol Imperial Worlds, Genari United Empire, and Ma'Alaketh Confederation.
[/b]
Some new updates:

[h1]Dyson Sphere[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/15e9ce5ca4eadb5e81db531efb1a4df54c24012b.jpg[/img]
The Ma'Alaketh Homeworld now has a Dyson Sphere.  It is heavily shielded and has a massive defense particle beam, but is vulnerable once its shields are down.  If an opposing race wants to defeat the Ma'Alaketh, they must destroy the Maal Homeworld Sphere.

[i]Essentially a Dyson Sphere built around the dwarf star supporting the Ma'Alaketh homeworld Do'Oran,  it is nearly 16,000km in circumference, and has become the center of innovation and technology for the Ma'Ali people.   After planet Do'Oran became an unsustainable world because of excessive abuse of its natural resources and atmosphere, the Ma'Ali found other worlds that would become their new homes.  However, during that profound technological singularity, a new grand project was initiated.   Harnessing the power of their dying star, they built a new world around it, and within two centuries completed this technological marvel.   It has seen many improvements and changes since; from its interior becoming not only the center for technology, but for trade, finance, and even agri/aqua culture.  It sustains the Ma'Ali race, and is the new seat of the High Advisors' council.  
As the threat of the  Sol & Genari aggression became more of a potential threat, this relatively fragile sphere was implemented with a powerful force field that can absorb 144 terajoules of energy at any time.   It also has a singular defensive particle beam that could theoretically destroy a warship with one blast alone.   Because of the tremendous power this sphere sustains, in theory if it was destroyed, it would produce a small nova-like wave that would destroy anything within 4000 kilometers around it.[/i]

[h1]Genari & Sol Type II ships now are available as starter ships.[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/f889e35238c9ce5d47d9668a5c500f3d5025c2a6.png[/img]
Increasing the selection of starter ships, Type II (usually more defensive variants) are now unlocked and usable as a starter ship for new players.   The Ma'Alaketh Wraith type I has also been unlocked as a starter ship.

[h1]Sol now has Marines![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/db5567136f9368e5daebd8b33cc195ea2ebe32ac.jpg[/img]
Albeit in a limited fashion, Sol Imperial Worlds marines are now available on the [b]Swordfish Type II Marine Destroyer[/b], as well as the new [b]Oslo V Marine Frigate[/b].   The Chief Medical officer has been upgraded with the Elite Marines skill.

[i]The Oslo has been proven to be a very capable warship, though not considered a front-line frigate like its Gorshkov and Liverpool counterparts.   It has had a dynamic role in the war however, recently converted to a tender/warship hybrid, and now modified to carry marine pods.  Admiral Michiel Donitz, the mastermind of the Sol Imperial Special Marines push to be more engaged in the war effort saw the Oslo as a good test ship for a marine frigate.   Though not as effective against Genari, the new war on the Ma'Alaketh front was where these marines would be needed.  Trained to board and kill crew members on Ma'Alaketh corvettes and frigates, they have been proven very effective in disabling Ma'Alaketh ships.   Admiral Donitz hopes that the Admiralty will see this as a green light to move forward in retrofitting other Sol warships with marines.[/i]

[h1]The Hive Beta Testing[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/58d1edf5e8dac9b3bbe26c8c88ba25cf18c32b98.jpg[/img]
Two veteran volunteers will continue to test the hive, and many of its skills/features as well as its proboscis will be in the works.  The server after Rigel will be opening up the Hive to the public.

notes.title: The New Dreadnoughts
notes.content:
[h1]New Dreadnoughts for Sol and Genari to counter the Ma'Alaketh Sovereign.[/h1]

[i]As the war escalates, a new version of the Genari Leviathan is being developed.   It is also rumored that the Sirius shipyard is conceptualizing a new Colossus as a counter to the Ma'Alaketh awakening...[/i]

[h1]Colossus Type II Dreadnought[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/ef6ef960059aa35c911bf63cb77583d0d5f4c2da.jpg[/img]
After the sudden and unexpected incursion of the once-passive Ma'Alaketh, the Sol Imperium's dreadnought was no longer the most powerful warship on the battlefield.    The new enemy had become a real threat, and their long range particle beams laid waste to even the most battle-hardened Sol capital ships.     After 15 years in production, the Colossus needed an upgrade.  Special Operations, led by Admiral Kurosawa proposed a modified Colossus that harbored the same weapons as the Nagara, and a force field upgrade carried over from the Yamato Battleship.   So a joint operation at the Sirius shipyard produced the first type II variant of this dreadnought that could attempt to match the beam range and force field strength of comparable Ma'Alaketh ships.    Two weapon hardpoints were lost, as well as some superstructure overall, but its defensive shields were now the best the Sol Imperium had in its arsenal.   Although the ship was successful in countering a Sovereign class Battleship, it still may not fare well enough against Ma'Alaketh's ultimate weapon: the Grand Sovereign Dreadnought.

[h1]Leviathan Type II Dreadnought[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/b25a7e32acd29c0981ce7dea32c4b057e7c3a2a9.jpg[/img]
Nearly two decades into the Leviathan's first foray against the Sol Imperium, this lumbering monster of a ship found its best use against Sol battlestations, destroying them with close range weaponry and armor that could take the punishment and survive.   But with the Ma'Alaketh awakening, the Genari Empire found itself against even more advanced technology than their mortal enemy, the Sol Imperium.  Matriarch Zeranghi's frustration with the lack of technological breakthroughs forced her to compromise with what she was given; and if the most powerful ship in the Genari fleet was going to remain a close combat brawler, make it even more of one.  Removing all forward laser hardpoints and replacing them with fission warheads, the dreadnought now had even more firepower.   It also has nearly 20% more armor to take on the punishment it would expect before getting close to its target.  All this however forced a downgrade of the powerplant making it even less maneuverable; but at least the fission warheads' power requirements were significantly lower than the lasers they replaced.  Though dreadnoughts like the Colossus or the Grand Sovereign are technically stronger, if this ship manages to get close enough, the firepower can decimate through their shields with a massive warhead barrage.

notes.title: New PvP Server: Mercury I
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/81ca31c0e051a8b03255809e68605012c80ae6ab.jpg[/img]

[h1]Back to full-on PVP![/h1]

The Mercury server allows three races (Sol, Genari, Ma'Alaketh) to fight it out on even grounds for the first time in Space Wars history.   Some upgrades and tweaks behind the scenes have been made in preparation for this server, and also two new starter ships for Sol and Genari:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/3db134aa4cbb3dbca3cb99a6c956f2e823fb909b.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Monarch Stealth Corvette[/h1] (Sol)
[i]Special Operations focused on developing some of the most powerful ships in the Sol fleet, such as the Exeter and Yamato capital ships.   It is now well known that the dampening field technology the Exeter possesses under the guise of a Genari Monolith was some sort of reverse-engineering of stolen Ma'Alaketh tech, so in theory it could be applied to smaller ships as well.    Not as efficient as the Ma'Alaketh stealth technology, but effective enough, this miniaturized version could be placed on a small corvette-class ship and applied as a counter to the new Ma'Alaketh incursion.    Because of the significant power costs of the 'stealth device', power savings were made in the efficiency of the shield generator, and the return of rudimentary fission warheads.  The ship could deliver a payload of fission warheads in close combat, and evade enemy fire with enough distance from the target warship.  Still somewhat of an experimental design, it has found itself even more useful in combat against Genari corvettes.[/i]

[h1]The Vanguard Missile Corvette[/h1] (Genari)
[i]The newest Corvette-class warship uniquely designed by the Moshtigh matriarchy is a different take on the Star Warrior, whereby the ship focuses on a singular fission warhead.    The FW-6 is a more powerful, longer range weapon, used on the Victory class Light Cruiser -- and can be deployed with same potency as three of Star Warrior's missiles with one-third the power cost.   The superstructure  was designed with improved power collectors which increase the damage of the fission warheads by as much as 15%.   Some smart captains have trained their Tactical Officers to focus on creating stable overloading of the missile launcher, thus giving this weapon far greater potential.    As new as this ship is, it is unknown how popular it will be among battle-hardened Genari captains who take preference over more maneuverable warships.[/i]

[h1]The Avenger Suicide Corvette[/h1] (Genari, unique)
[i]Now with a war on three fronts, the Genari were losing ground to the sudden Ma'Alaketh awakening, and Sanethi captains were finding themselves in more desperate situations.   Ma'Al ships were harder to hit because of their dampening fields, and their shields too hard to penetrate with basic lasers.   Some captains would go suicide with higher powered, disposable ships like the Agile Flyer, using the ships' explosion as a way to knock down enemy shields and their weaker hulls.   Matriarch Zeranghi who found her forces at the forefront of the Ma'Al incursion devised a new corvette with a unique tactic in mind.   The Avenger is a small ship that could be produced cheaply and be mostly automated with only a token crew -- with one goal -- to explode adjacent enemy ships and stations.   With dual frigate-class FHD-5 fusion drives, it could propel itself quickly to an enemy target, and explode with very significant splash damage to all of its surroundings, destroying nearby enemy corvettes outright.   It has also been proven to be quite effective against Hive swarms, which could be disabled or destroyed by the explosion wave.   If anything, this ship is so fast that it can keep out of danger, and time its approach when it is strategically significant.[/i]

notes.title: SpaceWars Update V1.15
notes.content:
[b][h1]NEW SHIPS[/h1][/b]
[b]Mobile Repair Facilities[/b]

Though repair tenders (both Class IV Frigate and Class V Destroyer) are commonly used and quite popular, there has been work done on creating tenders that can support heavy repair bays.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/50deaca84a2c1a41b9f8f80734cdd976a7f2afe5.jpg[/img]
[h1]POLARIS MOBILE REPAIR FACILITY (SOL IMPERIAL WORLDS)[/h1]
As the Sol-Genari wars escalated with large scale conflicts between Cruisers and other capital ships, the need for a more comprehensive repair tender was needed.   Rear Admiral West, the original proponent of the Klondike pushed high command for a tender that could support repair bays found on stations that worked exclusively on capital ships.    Such a massive repair station would require a cruiser's superstructure to support, and even then it could not support a larger force field because of the mass requirements.   The Rear Admiral found it to be  invaluable however, as his fleet of Long Range Beam cruisers could fire at range, with  these tenders stationed behind moons or asteroids, ready to take in any Capital ship for repairs in the field without being forced to leave the region.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/ee4d4f55d16ffc6a10ccfd9c9297e9d444f50101.jpg[/img]
[h1]FAT GENSHAI MOBILE REPAIR FACILITY (GENARI UNITED EMPIRE)[/h1]
This oversized repair tender was purpose-built more as a defensive repair station that would occupy captured Sol regions after a successful Genari campaign.  Very slow and unwieldy, it tends to move short distances in preparation of a Sol counterattack.   Designed to repair capital ships, it also has 120 marines available to resupply ships with marine pods similar to the Destiny Troop Ships' role.    Because of the size of the large repair bays and engines needed to propel a ship of this size, there was no space to give this ship proper weapons systems.    As Fleet Commanders get used to this mobile repair facility, they've come to find it invaluable in important defensive operations.

[i]NOTE:  Capital Ship Commander skill required to operate these ships.[/i]

notes.title: SpaceWars Update V1.09
notes.content:
[h1]Two New Ship Variants[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/298d21daef039fab5f95a1ec118622d01be0400e.jpg[/img]

[b]SOL
Oslo Combat/Support Hybrid 
Class IV Frigate[/b]
The Oslo shows its age considerably in the late 22nd century, as it was very unpopular with commanders fighting at the border, aiming for the far superior Gorshkov and Liverpool frigates.   Rear Admiral  Musashi decided to refit some of the underused Oslo ships with repair bays, so that they became sturdy support ships for the front line.  Unfortunately two of the beams had to be removed for the repair bay, but they were upgraded to the most powerful LB-9 type lasers which could put out significant damage if fully charged.
This rare variant of the Oslo is the only combat warship with repair support capabilities.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/f703b38b7351b52eb9da02761c9d7f9937ef5b89.jpg[/img]

[b]GENARI
Predator Missile Ship
Class IV Frigate[/b]
On the surface, this seems to be the same Predator Frigate that the Talagh Matriarchy used as the mainstay of the their fleet.   Some were modified however; with the beams removed and replaced with similarly-powered missiles.   The power to damage ratio was improved, as well as the shield generator to the second generation variant.   With slightly reduced armor, it is not considered superior to the original Predator, but is popular with many captains for its missile loadout.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Update v1.06
notes.content:
•	The Commandeer mechanic has been improved, so when a Sol ship is commandeered by Genari other Sol ships will now be able to fire upon the commandeered ship. •	A server greeting message system has been added to the game.  When a player loads into the Spacedock for the first time during a play session they will be presented with a message tailored to the specific server.

Ships are limited to Class 4 Frigates and lower, and all variants can be unlocked for LP/HP (No Credits Required). Once players are ready to play in a competitive environment they can create a character the main server.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Update v1.05
notes.content:
-	The Commandeer game mechanic is now in-game.  Firing a Marine Pod that reduces a ship’s crew to zero will result in the marines taking over the ship and attempting to escape the map with the ship.  Due to the covert operations of the Marines’ operations, other Genari players will not be aware that a ship has been commandeered and will still be able to fire upon the ship.  When a commandeered ship leaves the map double experience will be awarded to all Genari players in the map with the majority of the experience going to the player who captured the ship.  The interaction for Sol players whose ships are commandeered will function the same as if their ship was destroyed with it going on cooldown if it isn’t a starter ship. The Commandeer skills for the Marine Commandeer will remain disabled for the time being.

Purchasing multiple of these at one time will extend the duration HP/LP will be doubled.
-	The Ship Glossary is now having its information dynamically populated so it will always be up to date with any design changes to ships and structures.
-	The chat bar will now be open by default.
-	The Genari captain skill Rally Offensive will now be refreshed upon returning to the shipyard after a ship’s destruction.
-	Players will now be able to correctly move in reverse with the Rotation skill if they have less than 2 or more but less than 3 movement points remaining.
-	The number of times a captain can be respecced has been increased to 6.

notes.content:
-Players now have the ability to sell their ships from the Ship Details or Shipyard section of the Spacedock.  40% of the Honor/Leadership point cost for the ship will be refunded to the player upon its sale.  All officers and their levels/skills on a ship that is sold will be lost.
-All sectors that contain a shipyard (EG: Earth) have had their faction limits doubled.
-The Evasive V skill for the Helmsman has had its modifier reduced to 25% from 30%.
-The ship skill Genari Monolith has had its modifier reduce to 5% from 10%.
-Leaving a map while still in combat will incur a retreat penalty preventing the player from re-entering that same sector with the same ship for a 30 minute period. The time remaining will appear on the disabled engage button.
-Repair ships will now generate XP for the player piloting only when another ship uses the repair points given to repair.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Update v0.15 + Permadeath Removal
notes.content:
[h1]Permadeath Removal[/h1]
[i]A lot of players found the game too hardcore; and wanted something less punishing if they lost their ships.  All higher tier ships from Class IV to Class X now get returned to you intact with current officer upgrades, but with the ship in 'cooldown' period from 3-7 days depending on the tier.[/i]

Permanent death on all class 4 and above ships including their officers has been removed and replaced with a cooldown timer.  Once destroyed the ship will go on cooldown in the player’s roster for a set amount of time depending on its class. Permanent death on all class 1-3 ships is still active but they have no cooldown.
Class 4-5: 2 days 12 hours
Class 6: 2 days 21 hours
Class 7: 3 days 11 hours
Class 8: 4 days
Class 9-10: 4 days 15 hours

-The Genari captain skill Honorable Death will now reduce the cooldown duration of ships by a percentage amount based on the skill tier.
Honorable Death I: reduces the cooldown by 30%
Honorable Death II:  reduces the cooldown by 60%

-The Sol officer skill Emergency Escape will now reduce the cooldown duration of ships by a percentage amount based on the skill tier.
Emergency Escape I - reduces the cooldown by 10%
Emergency Escape II - reduces the cooldown by 20%
Emergency Escape III - reduces the cooldown by 30%
Emergency Escape IV - reduces the cooldown by 40%
Emergency Escape V - reduces the cooldown by 60%

-Travel to isolated friendly sectors from an enemy controlled sector is no longer permitted.
-New Sol and Genari premium captain portraits have been added to the game.
-Fixed an issue where unopposed would be incorrectly triggered in combat resulting in gradual depletion of the defender’s siege points.
-The game will now do a better job handling resolution of combat if there is a ship in transit.
-Overhauled the leaderboard to address several issues with displaying information.

-Each ship class now has a specified faction value that contributes to the faction limit for a sector. The values are:
Class 1-3 Ships = 1
Class 4 Ships = 2
Class 5-6 Ships = 3
Class 7-8 Ships = 4
Class 9-10 Ships = 5
If a sector has reached the max combined ship value for a given faction players of that faction will no longer be able to travel to that region instead of entering the queue.

-Fixed an issue where the turn bar would not put ships in the correct order.

-Fixed an issue where the auto end turn wouldn’t trigger when pass turn was used.

-The duration for beam weapons has been increased.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Batch v0.12
notes.content:
Following the Lore behind Sol & Genari, some major Changes.  Sol have better engines, and force fields, Genari better armor.

Most Sol Imperial Worlds ships have a boost in power output:
-Most Class III: +1 Power
-All Class IV: +2 Power
-All Class V: +4 Power
-All Class VI-IX: +6 Power

All Sol Imperial Worlds ships have improved and more efficient force fields:
-All Class III-X: Increased tier efficiency (less power cost to charge shields) and introducing a fourth-level force field.  Smart players will make full use of this advantage and utilize their Science Officer to a greater extent.

Improved Survivability in Higher tier ships for both Sol and Genari:
-All Class 4 ships and higher get hull point boosts.

Power Output reduction for certain Genari Ships:
-Agile Flyer IV: -1 Power
-Interdictor III: -3 Power
-Victory III: -3 Power

Weapon Power reduction for two UltraFast Ships:
-Agile Flyer IV: From 1-2-1 to 1-1-1
-Mendi III: From 1-2-1 to 1-1-1

More changes coming on Tuesday, plus bug fixes and few features (eg. XP for tender repairs, other support ships, XP for engine hits).
